name: Hartley Transform for Memory Reduction
aliases: Hartley Transform for Frequency Domain Volume Rendering
definition: Uses the Hartley transform instead of the Fourier transform to map real functions to real spectra, eliminating complex numbers and reducing memory usage.
summary: Hartley Transform for Memory Reduction replaces the Discrete Fourier Transform with the Discrete Hartley Transform to map real-valued data directly to real-valued spectra, eliminating complex arithmetic and reducing memory requirements by half.
